A [[Color/Legends|green]]-bladed '''lightsaber''' was wielded by [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] prior to and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Fisto's blade saw action on a large number of battlefields against the [[Confederacy military/Legends|Confederacy military]], such as on [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Clone Wars)/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and [[Mission to Ord Cestus|Ord Cestus]]. Unlike normal [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], Kit Fisto's blade had a [[Bifurcating cyclical-ignition pulse|modification]] that allowed it to function underwater.

==Description==
Kit's lightsaber contained two [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystals]] employing a [[bifurcating cyclical-ignition pulse]]<ref name="JVS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> and, unlike most lightsabers, could function underwater.<ref name="Water War" />

==History==
[[File:Kit_cartoon.jpg|thumb|left|170px|Fisto fighting in the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Clone Wars)/Legends|Battle of Mon Calamari]].]]
Kit Fisto was skilled in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] and was a master of [[Form I/Legends|Shii-Cho]], which he mastered to its highest degree. He also displayed skill in [[Jar'Kai/Legends|Jar'Kai]], while dueling Grievous during his mission to the third moon of Vassek,<ref name="Lair of Grievous">{{TCW|Lair of Grievous}}</ref> and almost overpowered the cyborg, a feat few Jedi could match. Fisto was also adept with a [[Lightwhip/Legends|lightwhip]], as shown during the Bio-Droid Crisis.<ref name="The Cestus Deception">''[[The Cestus Deception]]''</ref> Fisto's Shii-Cho mastery allowed him to temporarily hold off [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] while [[Agen Kolar/Legends|Agen Kolar]] and [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] were both killed with a single blow.<ref name="EP3">{{Film|III}}</ref>

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the book ''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]'', Kit Fisto's lightsaber is depicted as blue, rather than green in all other appearances.
